messages:
olivia: quick design intake — noticed keyboard/focus issues in the rollout timeline when expanding a canary detail panel. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/rollout-focus-01.png luca: saw that too. when you expand the canary the focus jumps to the timeline container, not the panel header. users lose context. we should move focus to the first interactive inside the panel (close / details) and add aria-expanded on the trigger. priya: agree. also SR announcement is silent — screenreader doesn't announce 'Canary expanded' or the variant name. suggest adding an aria-live="polite" region that reads: "Canary expanded: v3.2.1 — 10% traffic". keeps it unobtrusive. ben: small CSS nits: the focus outline on the panel header is 1px and low-contrast. bump to 3px and use color token --focus-accent. visible focus helps keyboard users scan multiple open canaries quickly. :eye: luca: pseudo code for the trigger: ```html
``` when toggled, set aria-expanded to true and set focus to the first focusable element inside the panel. sam: also accessibility for the canary slider — needs keyboard support and aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow. current slider traps keyboard in some browsers. make sure focus can leave with Esc and Tab flows next to the variant actions. priya: on microcopy: the rollback CTA currently says just "Rollback". that's scary. propose "Rollback to previous stable version" and an inline hint: "This will redirect traffic to the last stable release and create a rollback event." helps when scanned quickly. kevin: +1 on copy. also request traceability: every rollback action should attach a small immutable note in the version-history entry: who did it, why, and a link to the changelist. shows in timeline diff. ben: timeline scrubber — when you scrub to a previous point, SR users need a clear announcement: "Viewing timeline at 2025-08-21 14:32 UTC — showing v3.1.0". also keyboard shortcut to step back by one commit would be neat. olivia: thanks all — good stuff. actionable summary: - lucca/luca: move focus to panel header + implement aria-expanded (owner: luca) - priya: implement aria-live reads + update rollback copy (owner: priya) - ben: update focus ring and timeline SR announcements (owner: ben) - sam: verify slider keyboard/escape behavior & add aria-valuenow (owner: sam) - kevin: add rollback event metadata to timeline (owner: kevin) I'll add tickets to the sprint board and drop the screenshot + annotation in Figma. :white_check_mark: design-bot: new ticket created: D-1248 "Rollout timeline: SR focus order + rollback microcopy". Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/D-1248 olivia: fab — will sync in tomorrow's design review at 11:00. if anyone wants to prototype the aria-live wording, ping me and I can help test with VoiceOver.
